_help: TikTok videos that fill the Discover tab for everyone. Add one entry per video: open a video in TikTok, tap Share > Copy link, paste it as the url, and pick a category from: comedy, music, dance, sports, gaming, animals, food, education, art, nature, tech, fashion, edits, movies. Optional: "rating": "everyone" | "teen" | "mature" (default teen). Ember checks every caption with its safety filter and skips anything harmful. After saving this file on GitHub, Render redeploys and the videos appear in Discover.
